artworks.title: La Promenade Publique
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner with aquatint on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (outer framing line): 36.6 x 60 cm (14 7/16 x 23 5/8 in.)
sheet (trimmed within the platemark): 45.2 x 63.7 cm (17 13/16 x 25 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a social gathering in an outdoor setting. Numerous elegantly dressed individuals are under a canopy of trees in a garden or park. In the foreground, there are chairs and a table with figures interacting. The participants wear 18th-century style clothing. The painting depicts movement and social dynamics. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: La Rose mal defendue
artworks.medium: color etching, stipple, and wash manner inked à la poupée
artworks.description: The painting depicts an opulent interior scene with three elaborately dressed figures on a sofa. One standing figure offers a rose while another seated figure extends an arm towards the flower. Items on the table include a pitcher, cup, and plate. The background has rich blue drapery drawn open to reveal a bed. Belongings on the floor include a hat, bag, and papers. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Honoré Fragonard, known for romantic and playful compositions.

artworks.title: La Rose mal defendue (The Poorly Defended Rose)
artworks.medium: etching, stipple, and wash manner with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image contains two individuals. The woman is sitting on a chair holding a pink rose, while the man stands beside her. They are in a richly decorated room with a canopy bed in the background. A table with a bowl, pitcher, and various objects is on the left, and the floor is scattered with items including an open book.

artworks.title: L'Oiseau privé
artworks.medium: etching, stipple, wash manner, and aquatint on light blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclining outdoors on a grassy patch next to foliage. She is in a relaxed, seated position with her right arm extended outwards and her left hand resting on her lap. She has curly hair adorned with a wreath of flowers and is wearing a flowing dress with a sash wrapped around her shoulders. Near her is a basket filled with flowers and a piece of paper. In the background are trees, shrubs, and an arched stone structure. To her left is a depiction of a cherub-like figure with a bow and arrow.

artworks.title: Pauvre Annette
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a seated position, looking slightly to the side. Her upper body is turned slightly towards the viewer while her legs are stretched out in front of her. She has light, curly hair that falls to her shoulders and wears a wide-brimmed straw hat adorned with a ribbon and flowers. Her facial features include a delicate nose and slightly smiling lips. She is dressed in a voluminous gown featuring layers of earthy colors, with a blueish underskirt and a warm-toned shawl. Her left hand rests on her lap. She wears a pendant on a ribbon around her neck. A large straw basket or bundle is positioned behind her, and she is surrounded by foliage with a large tree to the left. In the background, the scenery includes lush greenery with a mix of trees and bushy plants under a cloudy but bright sky. To the right, there is a large, overturned urn or terracotta vase resting on the ground.

artworks.title: Frascati
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a gathering in a grand room. The setting features an opulent interior with architectural elements such as gilded molding, tall windows draped with curtains, and classical statues. Large chandeliers hang in the center of the room. Figures dressed in formal attire are engaged in conversation, socializing, and leisure activities. Small groups of people are seated around tables, while others walk around the space. The painting captures the sophisticated atmosphere of the gathering.

artworks.title: Madame du Barry
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person's body within an oval frame. The person is seated in a slightly turned position facing the viewer. They have delicate facial features with a smooth complexion, prominent eyebrows, and a slight smile. Their hair is styled in an 18th-century fashion, powdered and arranged in soft waves. The clothing is formal, featuring a high-collared shirt with intricate lacework and a buttoned coat with noticeable texture. The background consists of a patterned surface enclosed by a decorative oval border.

artworks.title: Jeanne Bécu, Comtesse Du Barry, Being Offered a Cup of Coffee by Zamor
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste-André Gautier Dagoty after François-Hubert Drouais
artworks.medium: color mezzotint in four colors on laid paper
artworks.description: The painting depicts a woman from the waist up, sitting on a chair with crossed legs. She has a round face, light skin, rosy cheeks, and her expression faces the viewer. Her hair is styled in an elaborate manner typical of the period, likely powdered and arranged upwards. She wears a white garment with lace details and holds a teacup and saucer. A man in a colorful coat and blue feathered turban is serving her, holding a tray with a small kettle. In the background are draped green and beige curtains, suggesting a setting with a canopy or bed. The scene exudes an atmosphere of luxury.

artworks.title: The Comte d'Artois and His Sister Mademoiselle Clotilde
artworks.description: The image shows a classic portrait of two children. They are positioned next to each other, with the child on the left sitting on a stone slab or low wall covered by a drapery, and the child on the right standing beside them with one hand resting on a large sheep. The child on the left wears a bonnet and an ornate gown with lace details, holding a basket of fruit. The child on the right has curly hair styled away from the face and is dressed in an intricately embroidered coat with a sash, holding a whip or switch. They are in a naturalistic setting with dense foliage in the background, suggesting a garden or forest, with a partly cloudy sky above. The image is rendered in monochrome, giving it an elegant and timeless quality.

artworks.title: Roxelane
artworks.artist: Pierre Adrien Le Beau after Jean-Demosthene Dugourc
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman within a circular frame. She is turned slightly to her right, holding her hair with her left hand. The woman has delicate facial features with a composed expression and is wearing a robe-like garment. In her right hand, she holds a long object. To her left, there is a table with a vase of flowers. The background shows draped fabric or curtains, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Le charlatan français
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with a crowd gathered around a figure standing on a platform. The drawing depicts a public event or market, with the central figure gesturing towards the crowd. Animals, including a horse, are also present. The people are dressed in historical clothing reminiscent of the 18th century, with tricorn hats and elaborate coats. The background includes a large colonnade and a banner hanging from the platform. The scene is busy and lively, with precise line work and hatchings used to create depth and movement.

artworks.title: Le charlatan allemand
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene featuring a central figure on horseback addressing a gathered crowd. The composition shows various people surrounding the mounted character, who is gesturing with a bottle in hand. The horse is detailed, and there are architectural elements in the background, including a building with a sign and a window with a figure. An ornate tree and a small resting dog are present in the scene. The drawing captures the dynamic interactions of the crowd, offering insight into the social atmosphere of the setting.

artworks.title: L'accord du mariage
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of elegantly dressed people in an ornate room. The room is lavishly decorated with detailed furniture and decorations, intricate patterns on the walls and frames, and a grand window allowing natural light inside. The figures are dressed in luxurious clothing, and a small dog is also present in the scene. The drawing style shows meticulous attention to detail reminiscent of engravings or etchings.

artworks.title: Concert Méchanique
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a musical performance featuring musicians playing various instruments around a harpsichord. A small figure sits on top of the harpsichord music stand. The setting is ornate with drapery and a chandelier, and detailed architectural elements like columns and decorative panels are present. The drawing conveys a sense of grandeur and elegance.

artworks.title: Concert Méchanique
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in elaborate attire gathered around a harpsichord in an ornately decorated indoor setting. A person plays the cello while another is at the harpsichord. The individuals have detailed facial features, wear wigs, and one woman wears a fancy dress and hairpiece. A small figure resembling Cupid is on the harpsichord. The room has heavy drapery, architectural details, and a chandelier illuminating the scene.

artworks.title: Dame a sa toilette
artworks.description: This print shows a man and woman seated on the edge of a bed in a well-decorated room. The man is leaning towards the woman, with one of his hands on her waist. He has pale skin and curled white hair, and he wears a fitted jacket, a waistcoat, knee-length breeches, and stockings. The woman sits with her body facing us and her head turned towards the man. She also has pale skin, and her hair is styled in an elaborate updo under a cap or bonnet. She is dressed in a detailed gown with lace and ruffles, a bodice with a low neckline, and a full skirt. In one hand she appears to hold a needle with a long thread connected to it, which stretches across her lap and loops around her other hand. The room is elegantly furnished with heavy drapes, a table with a mirror and a vase of flowers, and a chair or stool with cloth piled on it. A decorative oval frame with a sculpted relief or painting is on the wall behind them.

artworks.title: L'amant pressant
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman seated in a lavishly decorated room. The woman is on an ornate chair with her body turned towards the man, while the man is on a separate chair, leaning in towards her with one knee on the floor. The woman has an intricate hairstyle with a decorative piece on top and wears an elaborate gown. The man has a powdered wig, high collar, and is dressed in a coat with embroidery. They are in front of a paneled wall with a framed oval artwork and luxurious drapes.

artworks.title: Le jour
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: The image features a woman seated on a chair with several people around her, all within an ornate border. The woman has elaborate facial features, styled hair, and wears a voluminous dress. Two men and a woman interact with her; one man offers flowers, while the others stand behind them. A small dog is also visible on the floor. The background shows a decorated room with curtains, a tapestry, and an open door leading to another space.

artworks.title: La nuit
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in an ornately decorated interior. Four individuals are sitting in ornate chairs. One man wearing a wig and an ornate coat is seated next to a woman in an elaborate dress and decorative cap. Another woman holding a candelabra with lit candles is seated opposite them. A large, intricately detailed canopy bed with luxurious drapery is behind them, matching the room's detailed wallpaper and furnishings. The room is framed by lavish trimmings, emphasizing the intricate design.

artworks.title: Le belle nourrice
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: A group of people are in a lavishly decorated room. Five adults and one child are visible, with some seated on chairs in a semicircle. The child is held by a woman seated in the center. The individuals are dressed in elaborate 18th-century clothing, with detailed hairstyles. Other elements in the image include a standing woman holding fabric, a man holding a hat and walking stick, and a woman wearing a small crown. The background features a grand fireplace mantel, wall panels, an ornate carpet, and a dog.

artworks.title: La jolie fermiere
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a richly decorated room from a historical period. The room features elaborate furniture, artworks, a large window with draped curtains, a dog near the window, ornate furnishings, detailed moldings and frames, large portraits on the walls, a decorative clock, a fireplace with vases, sculptures, and ornaments. The drawing is detailed with intricate line work and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Le matin
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: The image shows three people in an indoor setting. In the center is a seated woman, with a man on her left leaning towards her and another person standing behind her tending to her hair. The seated woman appears serene and is wearing a loose-fitting gown. The man beside her wears a coat and breeches, with styled hair. The person attending to her has simpler attire, possibly indicating a servant. A table on the left holds a pitcher and goblet. On the right, a window with drapery lets in light, with a bird on a stand nearby and a small dog on a cushioned stool. The background features rich decor like curtains, tapestries, and artwork.

artworks.title: Le midi
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring an opulent room with classical elements. The room includes columns and decorative archways. In the center, there is a table with drapery, surrounded by three seated figures having a conversation over a meal. To the right, another figure stands holding a serving dish, next to a seated dog. The space is decorated with floral arrangements, vases, and a detailed drapery in the background. The composition is framed by architectural elements, adding depth to the scene. The drawing showcases intricate detail and shading reminiscent of 18th-century European art, capturing the social and material culture of the period.

artworks.title: L'apres-midi
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor social gathering. The scene features several individuals gathered around a small table in a classical setting with tall columns and an ornamental garden in the background, including a fountain and statues. The participants are engaged in conversation and are dressed in formal, period attire. A parrot is perched on the pillar. The architectural elements and scenery show precision and style typical of the period, emphasizing a balance between nature and human-made structures.
